remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before saving drafts, minimize stored personal data, and document retention and access controls for memory files.

remediation.issue: Optional connector references could be mistaken for automatic integrations.
remediation.suggestion: State clearly that connectors require user authorization and that no external action occurs without explicit confirmation.

content.value_statement: Influencer deals often leave rights, payment, and disclosure terms unclear. This skill creates structured drafts and reviews that make open terms visible before legal review.
actual_capabilities: Collect contract parameters for parties, deliverables, compensation, platforms, rights, and exclusivity.
Draft an influencer agreement using an eleven-section framework.
Review pasted agreement terms and identify missing essential terms and negotiation red flags.
Explain the purpose and tradeoffs of usage rights, whitelisting, exclusivity, approval, and termination clauses.
Prepare a negotiation cheat sheet with open terms and standard ranges.
Create a simplified agreement structure for smaller creator partnerships.
limitations: This skill provides general information and is not legal advice.
A qualified lawyer must review contracts before signing or relying on them.
It cannot verify local law, enforceability, tax treatment, or regulatory requirements for a specific deal.
Optional CRM, creator database, and e-signature connectors require separate authorization and setup.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first creator agreement
use_cases.description: Build a complete agreement outline for a new campaign and mark missing commercial decisions.

use_cases.title: Review an agency contract
use_cases.description: Assess pasted agency terms for unclear rights, payment, exclusivity, approval, and termination provisions.

use_cases.title: Standardize partnership templates
use_cases.description: Create reusable agreement structures that teams can adapt for recurring creator collaborations.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a simple agreement
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a simple influencer agreement for two Instagram posts at $500. Include payment timing, disclosure, and non-exclusive owned-channel usage.

prompt_templates.title: Review pasted terms
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these influencer agreement terms. List missing essential terms, red flags, and questions to resolve before legal review: [paste terms].

prompt_templates.title: Compare usage-rights options
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three usage-rights options for a TikTok campaign. Compare duration, channels, paid amplification, modification rights, and suggested compensation impact.

prompt_templates.title: Build a negotiation brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this proposed creator deal into a negotiation cheat sheet. Separate non-negotiable terms, flexible terms, risks, and questions for counsel: [deal details].

output_examples.input: Draft an agreement for two Instagram posts for $500.
output: A short agreement outline identifies the parties, two posts, approval dates, and a $500 payment schedule.
It proposes non-exclusive owned-channel usage for twelve months and requires clear sponsored-content disclosure.
It marks governing law and tax details for legal review.

output_examples.input: Review an agency request for perpetual paid usage and category exclusivity.
output: The review flags perpetual paid usage as a high-value right that needs separate scope and compensation.
It asks for a defined competitor category, territory, and exclusivity period.
It recommends counsel review before accepting indemnity and termination language.

best_practices: Provide complete deal facts, including platform, deliverables, payment, timeline, and intended usage.
Treat every draft as a discussion document until qualified legal counsel approves it.
Define rights duration, channels, territory, exclusivity scope, and payment timing in clear terms.
anti_patterns: Do not sign a generated draft without legal review.
Do not leave usage rights, paid amplification, or exclusivity terms undefined.
Do not paste confidential contract data into systems that are not authorized to handle it.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides general drafting and review guidance. Consult qualified legal counsel before execution.

faq.question: Can it draft a contract from a short brief?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a structured draft from available deal details and mark missing terms as TBD.

faq.question: Can it review an existing agreement?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the relevant terms for a clause-by-clause checklist, red flags, and questions for counsel.

faq.question: Does it send contracts for signature?
faq.answer: No. E-signature services are optional connectors and require separate setup and authorization.

faq.question: What rights can it help clarify?
faq.answer: It covers ownership, licensing, paid amplification, duration, territory, modification, and sublicensing considerations.

faq.question: Which deals benefit from this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for creator partnerships that need clear deliverables, compensation, disclosure, approval, and rights terms.
